title: Paper Dragon
reference: forward F1(4) def F1 { F1 turn_right F2 forward turn_right } def F2 { turn_left forward F1 turn_left F2 }
hints: Fold a strip of paper in half again and again, then open it out: that is the path. F1 folds one way, F2 the other.
Main: forward, F1(4). F1: F1, turn right, F2, forward, turn right. F2: turn left, forward, F1, turn left, F2.
forward F1(4) def F1 { F1 turn_right F2 forward turn_right } def F2 { turn_left forward F1 turn_left F2 }

story.intro: PATCH: "The last walk of the Cloister is a famous one, the dragon curve. Two functions, and each one calls both."
story.outro: PATCH: "Twelve blocks for forty-five steps. Folds inside folds."
